answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 46478 Country: India Title: Property distribution Question: After the death of parents how can a property be distributed among a son and two daughters? Answer ID: 46478 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1066/1066/M=1434) It shall be divided as per the rule of للذكر مثل حظ الانثيين (male will have double of the female’s share). The whole property left by the deceased person shall be divided into 4 shares, after paying due right preceding inheritance. Out of the total, 1-1 share shall go to each daughter and 2 shares to the son. Details: Son: 1x2=2 Daughters: 2x1=2 Total: 4 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
